decision.observation: 4:50 pm, rain; clock frozen. The farmer stands on the paving at the tight gate column (~0.63,0.45), blocked from moving north. The paddock's opening faces south toward the yard, and the farm's east road (dark stone strip) runs along the right edge with bushes and an 'E' marker.
decision.hypothesis: This tight fence gate won't pass; the reliable day-2 route to town is via the farm's east road, so exiting the paddock south then going east to the right-edge road and north should reach the bus stop area and town.
decision.memory: Tight offset fence yard north of the farmhouse; north passage unreliable. Day-2 town route: farmyard → east past mailbox → north along the east-edge road past the bus stop → east to the plaza. Introductions 6/28; 450g; axe selected.
